definition: Xinhua News Agency and Sogou of China developed an artificial intelligence (AI) for news reporting purposes.
details: The AI was unveiled in 2018. It is touted to be the "world's first AI news anchor".
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. What gets measured is what actually gets better. And that, done honestly, is Xinhua–Sogou AI news anchor.
